verdict.rationale: The only official SDK evidenced is the first-party React hook and component for Teller Connect under the tellerhq GitHub org, which covers frontend account linking but not the core API (balances, transactions, identity, payments). Those endpoints appear to be consumed directly over mTLS-authenticated REST. The community export script is a third-party project and earns no credit. Missing for 10: official server-side/backend API client SDKs in any language, multi-language SDK coverage, SDK documentation beyond a repo description, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
